name: qa-warden
description: AI-written Playwright E2E tests from plain-language specs. The healer can fix selectors, never assertions: a verifier breaks the app in the ways the spec lists and checks the test goes red, and a reviewer blocks the PR when spec and test disagree. Nightly runs are plain Playwright at $0 LLM cost. Run /qa-warden:init in the project after install.
